# Item Types

<!-- Generated by scripts/bundle-schemas.mjs from schemas/. Do not edit: change the schemas and run it again. -->

What each type of overlay, annotation and library resource is for, and what its `frametrail:attributes` hold. The source is the JSON Schemas in [`schemas/attributes/`](../schemas/attributes/); [DATA-MODEL.md](DATA-MODEL.md) explains the items these attributes belong to.

## At a Glance

| Type | Overlay | Annotation | Library | What it is |
|------|:-------:|:----------:|:-------:|------------|
| `text` | ✓ | ✓ |  | Text overlay or annotation: rich text with an optional title, plain or in a shape (rectangle, rounded rectangle, circle, speech bubble, cloud, block arrow), for titles, captions, callouts and labels. |
| `html` | ✓ | ✓ |  | Custom HTML overlay or annotation, for what the other types cannot show. |
| `quiz` | ✓ | ✓ |  | Quiz overlay or annotation: a question with answers to choose, or asking for a free text or a rating, at a point in the video. |
| `hotspot` | ✓ |  |  | Hotspot overlay: a clickable shape (circle, rectangle, rounded rectangle) that marks something in the picture and can open a URL or jump to a time or another hypervideo, or a drawn mark (arrow, underline, freeform outline) that points something out. |
| `cursor` | ✓ |  |  | Cursor overlay: a mouse pointer with click ripples, for walking through a screen recording. |
| `counter` | ✓ |  |  | Counter overlay: a number that counts up or rolls like an odometer, for a figure or statistic the video mentions. |
| `chart` | ✓ |  |  | Chart overlay: an animated bar, line or donut chart, or a progress ring, for numbers the video talks about. |
| `image` | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | Image: a picture, diagram or photo. |
| `video` | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | Video file (MP4, WebM or HLS) shown over or beside the hypervideo's own video. |
| `audio` | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | Audio file with player controls: narration, music, a sound clip. |
| `pdf` | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | PDF document in a viewer: a handout, a paper, slides. |
| `youtube` | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | YouTube video. |
| `vimeo` | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | Vimeo video. |
| `wistia` | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | Wistia video. |
| `loom` | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | Loom video. |
| `twitch` | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | Twitch video or live channel. |
| `soundcloud` | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | SoundCloud track or playlist. |
| `spotify` | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | Spotify track, album, playlist or podcast. |
| `webpage` | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | Web page shown in an iframe, or as a card when the site forbids embedding. |
| `wikipedia` | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | Wikipedia article summary, for background on a term, a person or an event. |
| `entity` | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | Linked data entity, such as a Wikidata item: a person, place or concept with its description. |
| `location` | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | Map (OpenStreetMap via Leaflet) centred on a coordinate, for a place the video shows or mentions. |
| `mastodon` | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | Mastodon post. |
| `codepen` | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | CodePen embed: a live HTML, CSS and JavaScript demo. |
| `figma` | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | Figma embed: a design file or prototype. |
| `urlpreview` | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | Link preview card: title, description and image of a page, or the platform's own embed for posts from Bluesky, X, TikTok, SlideShare, Reddit and Flickr. |

Overlay: an item of `hypervideo.json` → `contents`, shown over the video. Annotation: an item of a user's annotation file. Library: a resource of `resources/_index.json`, which overlays and annotations can be made from. The type is the body's `frametrail:type`.

## Every Overlay

Every overlay type also takes these attributes; annotations do not use them.

| Attribute | Type | Values | Default | Description |
|-----------|------|--------|---------|-------------|
| `opacity` | number | 0–1 | `1` | Opacity of the overlay. |
| `hoverStyle` | object |  |  | How the overlay changes on hover. Missing means it does not change. |
| `hoverStyle.opacity` | number | 0–1 | `0.85` | Opacity while hovered. |
| `hoverStyle.scale` | number |  | `1.05` | Scale while hovered. |
| `hoverStyle.borderColor` | string |  |  | CSS border colour while hovered. Empty means none. |
| `hoverStyle.backgroundColor` | string |  |  | CSS background colour while hovered. Empty means none. |
| `zIndex` | integer | ≥ 0 |  | Stacking order among the hypervideo's overlays (0 = bottom). Missing means creation order. |
| `animation` | object |  |  | Overlay animation. Transitions frame the time span: the overlay is fully present and clickable for exactly [start, end]. Missing phases have no animation. Replaces the legacy animationIn / animationOut / animationDuration attributes on the first edit in the Animation tab. See [Animation](#animation). |
| `animationIn` | string | `fade`, `slideLeft`, `slideRight`, `slideUp`, `slideDown`, `zoom` |  | Legacy. Entrance of overlays saved before the Animation tab existed, mapped to animation.in when read. Ignored when animation is present. |
| `animationOut` | string | `fade`, `slideLeft`, `slideRight`, `slideUp`, `slideDown`, `zoom` |  | Legacy. Exit of overlays saved before the Animation tab existed, mapped to animation.out when read. Ignored when animation is present. |
| `animationDuration` | number or string |  | `300` | Legacy. Duration of animationIn and animationOut in milliseconds. |

## Types

### `text`

Text overlay or annotation: rich text with an optional title, plain or in a shape (rectangle, rounded rectangle, circle, speech bubble, cloud, block arrow), for titles, captions, callouts and labels. Over a busy picture a filled shape keeps the text readable; a shape may also stand alone, without text.

Overlay, annotation. Its src, if it has one, goes into `body.value`. Schema: [`attributes/text.schema.json`](../schemas/attributes/text.schema.json).

| Attribute | Type | Values | Default | Description |
|-----------|------|--------|---------|-------------|
| `text` | string |  | `""` | The text. HTML, stored HTML-escaped ("&lt;p&gt;Hello&lt;/p&gt;"); FrameTrail unescapes it before rendering. |
| `title` | string |  |  | Optional title, plain text, shown above the text. |
| `box` | object |  |  | On overlays: the shape the text is in, and its style. Pixels are pixels of the overlay stage taken as 800 px wide, so the shape scales with the player. Missing means plain text: no fill, no outline, no padding. |
| `box.shape` | string | `rectangle`, `rounded`, `circle`, `speechBubble`, `cloud`, `arrow` |  | The shape. Circle, speech bubble, cloud and block arrow centre the text in them. Missing (cards made before shapes): rounded when radius is above 0, else rectangle. |
| `box.direction` | string | `right`, `left`, `up`, `down`, `upRight`, `upLeft`, `downRight`, `downLeft`, `none` |  | speechBubble: where the tail points (default downLeft). cloud: where its two trailing circles go (default downLeft), none for a cloud without them. arrow: where the arrow points, right, left, up or down (default right); other directions come from rotating the overlay. |
| `box.background` | string |  | `transparent` | CSS fill colour. Missing or "transparent" means no fill. |
| `box.textColor` | string |  |  | CSS colour of the text and the title; colours set in the text win. Missing means the default text colour (black on overlays). |
| `box.titleColor` | string |  |  | CSS colour of the title. Missing means the text colour. |
| `box.padding` | number | ≥ 0 |  | Space between the shape and the text, in pixels. |
| `box.radius` | number | ≥ 0 |  | rounded and speechBubble: corner radius in pixels (default 12). Ignored by the other shapes. |
| `box.borderWidth` | number | ≥ 0 | `0` | Outline width in pixels. 0 means no outline. |
| `box.borderColor` | string |  | `#000000` | CSS outline colour. |
| `box.shadow` | boolean |  | `false` | Draw a drop shadow. |
| `autoSize` |  | `height` |  | On overlays: "height" makes the box as high as its content (title, text and shape). The editor sets the height whenever the content or the width changes; only the width is set by hand. When shown, the content is never clipped, even where other fonts make it longer. Missing means the box keeps the size it was given. |

### `html`

Custom HTML overlay or annotation, for what the other types cannot show. Not sanitised.

Overlay, annotation. Its src, if it has one, goes into `body.source`. Schema: [`attributes/html.schema.json`](../schemas/attributes/html.schema.json).

| Attribute | Type | Values | Default | Description |
|-----------|------|--------|---------|-------------|
| `text` | string |  | `""` | The HTML source. HTML, stored HTML-escaped ("&lt;p&gt;Hello&lt;/p&gt;"); FrameTrail unescapes it before rendering. |

### `quiz`

Quiz overlay or annotation: a question with answers to choose, or asking for a free text or a rating, at a point in the video. In an annotation it is answered where it is shown, by the viewer and on paired phones, and the answers decide what happens next: a multipleChoice quiz does what the answer with the most votes says (its action: continue, stay paused, jump to a time, open a hypervideo or show a link), the other types do what onAnswered says. A quiz pauses the video when it starts if the item has frametrail:pause (quizzes made in the editor do); without it the vote runs while the video plays and is decided when the quiz ends. Quizzes saved before per-answer actions have the outcomes onCorrectAnswer, onWrongAnswer and onAnswered with showText and resumePlayback instead, which are read as actions until the quiz is next changed in the editor.

Overlay, annotation. Its src, if it has one, goes into `body.value`. Schema: [`attributes/quiz.schema.json`](../schemas/attributes/quiz.schema.json).

| Attribute | Type | Values | Default | Description |
|-----------|------|--------|---------|-------------|
| `questionType` | string | `multipleChoice`, `multiSelect`, `freeText`, `rating` | `multipleChoice` | multipleChoice: one answer; the answer with the most votes decides. multiSelect: several answers. freeText: a text response. rating: a numeric scale. Only multipleChoice answers have actions; the other types use onAnswered. |
| `question` | string |  |  | The question, plain text. |
| `answers` | array of objects |  |  | multipleChoice and multiSelect: the answers. |
| `answers[].text` | string |  |  | Required. Answer text, plain text. |
| `answers[].correct` | boolean |  | `false` | Whether this answer is correct: shown as right or wrong after the quiz is decided. It decides nothing (in legacy quizzes it chose between onCorrectAnswer and onWrongAnswer). |
| `answers[].action` | string | `""`, `pause`, `openUrl`, `jumpToTime`, `jumpToHypervideo` | `""` | multipleChoice: what happens when this answer is decided. A quiz whose answers and onAnswered have no action is a legacy quiz (onCorrectAnswer, onWrongAnswer). |
| `answers[].actionTarget` | string or number |  |  | Target of the action: a URL for openUrl (one starting with # changes the page hash), seconds of the video for jumpToTime, a hypervideo id for jumpToHypervideo. |
| `answers[].actionTargetTime` | number or string |  |  | jumpToHypervideo only: the time in seconds to start the target hypervideo at. Empty or 0 means its start. |
| `answers[].feedback` | string |  |  | Text shown with the result after the quiz is decided. |
| `answers[].default` | boolean |  | `false` | multipleChoice: the answer decided when the votes are tied or nobody answered before the countdown ended. Without one, a tie goes to the tied answer listed first and no votes to the first answer. At most one; the first counts. |
| `onCorrectAnswer` | object |  |  | Legacy. multipleChoice and multiSelect: what happens after a correct answer, read when no answer has an action. Replaced by the answers' actions (multiSelect: by onAnswered) on the first change in the editor. |
| `onCorrectAnswer.showText` | string or boolean |  | `false` | Legacy. Text shown in a dialog after answering. false means none. |
| `onCorrectAnswer.resumePlayback` | boolean |  | `true` | Legacy. Resume playback after answering. |
| `onCorrectAnswer.jumpForward` | number or boolean |  | `false` | Legacy. Seconds to jump forward from where the quiz was answered. false or 0 means no jump. Read as jumpToTime. |
| `onWrongAnswer` | object |  |  | Legacy. multipleChoice and multiSelect: what happens after a wrong answer, read when no answer has an action. Replaced by the answers' actions (multiSelect: by onAnswered) on the first change in the editor. |
| `onWrongAnswer.showText` | string or boolean |  | `false` | Legacy. Text shown in a dialog after answering. false means none. |
| `onWrongAnswer.resumePlayback` | boolean |  | `true` | Legacy. Resume playback after answering. |
| `onWrongAnswer.jumpBackward` | number or boolean |  | `10` | Legacy. Seconds to jump back from where the quiz was answered. false or 0 means no jump. Read as jumpToTime. |
| `onAnswered` | object |  |  | multiSelect, freeText and rating: what happens after the quiz is decided. |
| `onAnswered.showText` | string or boolean |  | `false` | Legacy. Text shown after answering, read as feedback while onAnswered has no action. false means none. |
| `onAnswered.resumePlayback` | boolean |  | `true` | Legacy. Resume playback after answering, read as action "" (true) or "pause" (false) while onAnswered has no action. |
| `onAnswered.action` | string | `""`, `pause`, `openUrl`, `jumpToTime`, `jumpToHypervideo` | `""` | What happens after the quiz is decided: "" continues playing, "pause" leaves the video paused, "openUrl" shows a link (actionTarget) to open, "jumpToTime" goes to a time (actionTarget, seconds of the video) and plays on, "jumpToHypervideo" opens a hypervideo (actionTarget, its id; actionTargetTime where it starts). |
| `onAnswered.actionTarget` | string or number |  |  | Target of the action: a URL for openUrl (one starting with # changes the page hash), seconds of the video for jumpToTime, a hypervideo id for jumpToHypervideo. |
| `onAnswered.actionTargetTime` | number or string |  |  | jumpToHypervideo only: the time in seconds to start the target hypervideo at. Empty or 0 means its start. |
| `onAnswered.feedback` | string |  |  | Text shown with the result after the quiz is decided. |
| `ratingScale` | integer | 2–10 | `5` | rating: number of steps. |
| `countdown` | number | ≥ 0 | `0` | Annotations: seconds the viewers have to answer. When they are up the quiz is decided with the answers given (none: the default answer). 0 means no time limit: the quiz is decided when everyone answering has answered. |

### `hotspot`

Hotspot overlay: a clickable shape (circle, rectangle, rounded rectangle) that marks something in the picture and can open a URL or jump to a time or another hypervideo, or a drawn mark (arrow, underline, freeform outline) that points something out. Overlay only. A plain hotspot made in the editor pauses the video when it appears (frametrail:events onStart); the drawn marks do not.

Overlay. It has no src. Schema: [`attributes/hotspot.schema.json`](../schemas/attributes/hotspot.schema.json).

| Attribute | Type | Values | Default | Description |
|-----------|------|--------|---------|-------------|
| `shape` | string | `circle`, `rectangle`, `rounded`, `arrow`, `underline`, `freeform` | `circle` | The shape. |
| `color` | string |  | `#0096ff` | CSS colour of the outline (of the line for arrow and underline), and of the pulse. |
| `borderWidth` | number | 0–40 | `5` | Outline or line width in pixels. 0 means no outline. |
| `borderRadius` | number | ≥ 0 | `10` | rounded only: corner radius in pixels. |
| `backgroundColor` | string |  | `""` | CSS fill colour of the closed shapes (not drawn for arrow and underline). Empty means no fill. Where pulse is missing, a fill hides the pulse ring. |
| `pulse` | boolean |  |  | Closed shapes: show the pulse ring, an expanding ring in the outline colour. Missing means on unless the hotspot has a fill (hotspots made before the switch). Arrow and underline never pulse. |
| `text` | string |  | `""` | Label inside the hotspot, plain text. Not drawn for arrow and underline. |
| `textColor` | string |  | `#ffffff` | CSS colour of the label. |
| `direction` | string | `right`, `left`, `up`, `down`, `upRight`, `upLeft`, `downRight`, `downLeft` | `right` | arrow only: where the arrow points. |
| `curve` | string | `straight`, `curved`, `swoop` | `straight` | arrow only: straight, curved (one bend) or swoop (S-like). |
| `points` | array of objects |  |  | freeform only: the outline as points in 0–100 box coordinates. Smooth points let the outline curve through them, the others are corners. |
| `points[].x` | number |  |  | Required. Horizontal position in percent of the box. |
| `points[].y` | number |  |  | Required. Vertical position in percent of the box. |
| `points[].smooth` | boolean |  | `false` | Curve through this point instead of a corner. |
| `path` | string |  |  | freeform only: the outline as an SVG path in 0–100 box coordinates. Derived from points and written for other consumers; a shape that has only a path (older data) is drawn from it and converted to points on its first edit. |
| `linkUrl` | string |  |  | Legacy. URL opened on click, from before the action model. Treated as action "openUrl" when action is empty. |
| `action` | string | `""`, `openUrl`, `jumpToTime`, `jumpToHypervideo` |  | What a click does. Empty means nothing (custom code goes into the overlay's onClick event). |
| `actionTarget` | string or number |  |  | Target of the action: a URL for openUrl (one starting with # changes the page hash), seconds of the video for jumpToTime, a hypervideo id for jumpToHypervideo. |
| `actionTargetTime` | number or string |  |  | jumpToHypervideo only: the time in seconds to start the target hypervideo at. Empty or 0 means its start. |

### `cursor`

Cursor overlay: a mouse pointer with click ripples, for walking through a screen recording. Overlay only. It moves along the overlay's keyframes (box motion) and clicks at the times in clicks.

Overlay. It has no src. Schema: [`attributes/cursor.schema.json`](../schemas/attributes/cursor.schema.json).

| Attribute | Type | Values | Default | Description |
|-----------|------|--------|---------|-------------|
| `style` | string | `arrow`, `hand` | `arrow` | Pointer glyph. |
| `color` | string |  | `#ffffff` | CSS fill colour of the pointer and its ripples. |
| `outlineColor` | string |  | `#111111` | CSS outline colour of the pointer. |
| `clicks` | array of numbers or string |  | `[]` | Click times in seconds from the overlay's start. A string of numbers separated by commas, semicolons or spaces is read as well. |

### `counter`

Counter overlay: a number that counts up or rolls like an odometer, for a figure or statistic the video mentions. Overlay only.

Overlay. It has no src. Schema: [`attributes/counter.schema.json`](../schemas/attributes/counter.schema.json).

| Attribute | Type | Values | Default | Description |
|-----------|------|--------|---------|-------------|
| `from` | number |  | `0` | Start value. |
| `to` | number |  | `100` | End value. |
| `decimals` | integer | 0–4 | `0` | Decimal places. |
| `prefix` | string |  | `""` | Text before the number. |
| `suffix` | string |  | `""` | Text after the number. |
| `style` | string | `count`, `roll` | `count` | count: the value counts up. roll: the digits roll like an odometer. |
| `duration` | number | ≥ 0 | `1500` | Duration of the count in milliseconds, from the overlay's start. |
| `ease` | string | an ease, see [Eases](#eases) |  | Easing of the count. Default power2Out. |
| `color` | string |  | `#ffffff` | CSS text colour. |
| `weight` | number |  | `700` | CSS font weight. |
| `align` | string | `left`, `center`, `right` | `center` | Horizontal alignment. |

### `chart`

Chart overlay: an animated bar, line or donut chart, or a progress ring, for numbers the video talks about. Overlay only. The values are lines of text ("Label: value") in data.

Overlay. It has no src. Schema: [`attributes/chart.schema.json`](../schemas/attributes/chart.schema.json).

| Attribute | Type | Values | Default | Description |
|-----------|------|--------|---------|-------------|
| `chartType` | string | `bars`, `line`, `donut`, `ring` | `bars` | Kind of chart. |
| `data` | string |  | `""` | One "Label: value" per line ("=" works too); a line with only a number has an empty label. The ring uses the first value as a percentage. Grouping separators and a decimal comma are understood. |
| `unit` | string |  | `""` | Text after each value, e.g. "%". |
| `color` | string |  | `#4cc3ff` | CSS colour of the bars, line or segments. |
| `textColor` | string |  | `#ffffff` | CSS colour of labels and values. |
| `highlight` | integer | ≥ -1 | `-1` | Index of the item drawn highlighted. -1 means none. |
| `showValues` | boolean |  | `true` | Show the values. |
| `duration` | number | ≥ 0 | `1500` | Duration of the build-up in milliseconds, from the overlay's start. |

### `image`

Image: a picture, diagram or photo. The src is a file name in _data/resources/ or a URL.

Overlay, annotation, library resource. Its src, if it has one, goes into `body.source`. Schema: [`attributes/image.schema.json`](../schemas/attributes/image.schema.json).

No attributes of its own.

### `video`

Video file (MP4, WebM or HLS) shown over or beside the hypervideo's own video. The src is a file name in _data/resources/ or a URL. A video overlay can play along with the hypervideo while it is shown (autoPlay).

Overlay, annotation, library resource. Its src, if it has one, goes into `body.source`. Schema: [`attributes/video.schema.json`](../schemas/attributes/video.schema.json).

| Attribute | Type | Values | Default | Description |
|-----------|------|--------|---------|-------------|
| `autoPlay` | boolean |  | `false` | Overlays only: play in sync with the hypervideo while the overlay is active. |
| `alternateVideoFile` | string |  |  | Legacy. A second rendition of the video file. Not read. |

### `audio`

Audio file with player controls: narration, music, a sound clip. The src is a file name in _data/resources/ or a URL. An audio overlay can play along with the video while it is shown (autoPlay).

Overlay, annotation, library resource. Its src, if it has one, goes into `body.source`. Schema: [`attributes/audio.schema.json`](../schemas/attributes/audio.schema.json).

| Attribute | Type | Values | Default | Description |
|-----------|------|--------|---------|-------------|
| `autoPlay` | boolean |  | `false` | Overlays only: play in sync with the hypervideo while the overlay is active. |

PDF document in a viewer: a handout, a paper, slides. The src is a file name in _data/resources/ or a URL.

Overlay, annotation, library resource. Its src, if it has one, goes into `body.source`. Schema: [`attributes/pdf.schema.json`](../schemas/attributes/pdf.schema.json).

Twitch video or live channel. The src is the player URL, "https://player.twitch.tv/?video=<id>&parent=<host name of the page>" (or "?channel=<name>&parent=…").

No attributes of its own.

| Attribute | Type | Values | Default | Description |
|-----------|------|--------|---------|-------------|

Spotify track, album, playlist or podcast. The src is the open.spotify.com URL.

Overlay, annotation, library resource. Its src, if it has one, goes into `body.source`. Schema: [`attributes/spotify.schema.json`](../schemas/attributes/spotify.schema.json).

| Attribute | Type | Values | Default | Description |

### `webpage`

Web page shown in an iframe, or as a card when the site forbids embedding. The src is the page's URL.

Overlay, annotation, library resource. Its src, if it has one, goes into `body.value`. Schema: [`attributes/webpage.schema.json`](../schemas/attributes/webpage.schema.json).

| Attribute | Type | Values | Default | Description |
|-----------|------|--------|---------|-------------|
| `embed` | string | `allowed`, `forbidden` |  | Whether the site allows being embedded in an iframe, as detected when the resource was added. |
| `description` | string |  |  | Description shown on the card. HTML. |

### `wikipedia`

Wikipedia article summary, for background on a term, a person or an event. The src is the article's URL.

Overlay, annotation, library resource. Its src, if it has one, goes into `body.value`. Schema: [`attributes/wikipedia.schema.json`](../schemas/attributes/wikipedia.schema.json).

| Attribute | Type | Values | Default | Description |
|-----------|------|--------|---------|-------------|
| `articleUrl` | string |  |  | URL of the article. |
| `wikiLang` | string |  |  | Language code of the Wikipedia edition, e.g. "en". |
| `dir` | string | `ltr`, `rtl` | `ltr` | Text direction of the article. |
| `description` | string |  |  | Short description of the article. |
| `extract` | string |  |  | Summary, plain text. |
| `extract_html` | string |  |  | Summary, HTML. |

### `entity`

Linked data entity, such as a Wikidata item: a person, place or concept with its description. Its IRI is the item's frametrail:uri (or the body source).

Overlay, annotation, library resource. Its src, if it has one, goes into `body.value`. Schema: [`attributes/entity.schema.json`](../schemas/attributes/entity.schema.json).

| Attribute | Type | Values | Default | Description |
|-----------|------|--------|---------|-------------|
| `embed` | string | `allowed`, `forbidden` |  | Whether the entity page may be embedded. |
| `text` | string |  |  | Description of the entity. HTML, stored HTML-escaped ("&lt;p&gt;Hello&lt;/p&gt;"); FrameTrail unescapes it before rendering. |

### `location`

Map (OpenStreetMap via Leaflet) centred on a coordinate, for a place the video shows or mentions.

Overlay, annotation, library resource. Its src, if it has one, goes into `body.source`. Schema: [`attributes/location.schema.json`](../schemas/attributes/location.schema.json).

| Attribute | Type | Values | Default | Description |
|-----------|------|--------|---------|-------------|
| `lat` | number or string |  |  | Latitude (WGS 84). Resources store it as a string. |
| `lon` | number or string |  |  | Longitude (WGS 84). Resources store it as a string. |
| `boundingBox` | array of numbers or strings, or string |  |  | Area to fit the map to when zoom is not set: [south, north, west, east] in degrees, numbers or strings. An empty string or array means none. |
| `zoom` | integer | 0–20 | `15` | Zoom level. |
| `tileStyle` | string | `osm-standard`, `carto-light`, `carto-dark`, `carto-voyager` | `osm-standard` | Map tiles. |
| `marker` | object |  |  | The marker. |
| `marker.show` | boolean |  | `true` | Show a marker at the centre. |
| `marker.color` | string |  | `#e74c3c` | CSS colour of the marker. |
| `controls` | object |  |  | Map interaction. |
| `controls.dragging` | boolean |  | `true` | Allow panning. |
| `controls.scrollWheelZoom` | boolean |  | `true` | Allow zooming with the scroll wheel. |
| `controls.zoomControl` | boolean |  | `true` | Show the zoom buttons. |

### `mastodon`

Mastodon post. The src is the post's URL.

Overlay, annotation, library resource. Its src, if it has one, goes into `body.source`. Schema: [`attributes/mastodon.schema.json`](../schemas/attributes/mastodon.schema.json).

| Attribute | Type | Values | Default | Description |
|-----------|------|--------|---------|-------------|
| `html` | string |  |  | Embed HTML from the instance's oEmbed answer. Used instead of an iframe when present. |
| `embedUrl` | string |  |  | URL of the post's embed page. Missing means src + "/embed". |
| `instance` | string |  |  | Host name of the Mastodon instance. |

### `codepen`

CodePen embed: a live HTML, CSS and JavaScript demo. The src is the pen's embed URL, "https://codepen.io/<user>/embed/<id>?default-tab=result".

Overlay, annotation, library resource. Its src, if it has one, goes into `body.source`. Schema: [`attributes/codepen.schema.json`](../schemas/attributes/codepen.schema.json).

No attributes of its own.

### `figma`

Figma embed: a design file or prototype. The src is the file's URL on figma.com.

Overlay, annotation, library resource. Its src, if it has one, goes into `body.source`. Schema: [`attributes/figma.schema.json`](../schemas/attributes/figma.schema.json).

No attributes of its own.

### `urlpreview`

Link preview card: title, description and image of a page, or the platform's own embed for posts from Bluesky, X, TikTok, SlideShare, Reddit and Flickr. For showing what a link points to; webpage shows the page itself.

Overlay, annotation, library resource. Its src, if it has one, goes into `body.source`. Schema: [`attributes/urlpreview.schema.json`](../schemas/attributes/urlpreview.schema.json).

| Attribute | Type | Values | Default | Description |
|-----------|------|--------|---------|-------------|
| `originalType` | string | `bluesky`, `xtwitter`, `tiktok`, `slideshare`, `reddit`, `flickr` |  | The platform the URL belongs to. Set, html is rendered with the platform's embed script. |
| `html` | string |  |  | Embed HTML from the platform's oEmbed answer. |
| `photoUrl` | string |  |  | flickr only: URL of the photo. |
| `description` | string |  |  | Description shown on the card. HTML. |
| `embed` | string | `allowed`, `forbidden` |  | Legacy. Written by older versions when the resource was added. Not read. |

## Animation

Overlay animation. Transitions frame the time span: the overlay is fully present and clickable for exactly [start, end]. Missing phases have no animation. Replaces the legacy animationIn / animationOut / animationDuration attributes on the first edit in the Animation tab. Every overlay takes it as its `animation` attribute.

| Phase | What it is | Presets |
|-------|------------|---------|
| `in` | Entrance. It plays before the overlay's start (lead-in), clipped at the start of the video. | `fadeIn`, `slideFromLeft`, `slideFromRight`, `slideFromTop`, `slideFromBottom`, `zoomIn`, `popIn`, `blurIn`, `wipeFromLeft`, `wipeFromRight`, `wipeFromTop`, `wipeFromBottom`, `irisIn`, `dropIn`, `rotateIn`, `draw` |
| `emphasis` | Loop that plays within the overlay's time span. | `pulse`, `breathe`, `wobble`, `shake`, `bounce`, `float`, `heartbeat`, `flash`, `glow` |
| `out` | Exit. It plays after the overlay's end (trail-out). | `fadeOut`, `slideToLeft`, `slideToRight`, `slideToTop`, `slideToBottom`, `zoomOut`, `popOut`, `blurOut`, `wipeToLeft`, `wipeToRight`, `wipeToTop`, `wipeToBottom`, `irisOut`, `dropOut`, `rotateOut`, `undraw` |
| `text` | Text reveal (text overlays), within the span. | `fadeUp`, `fade`, `pop`, `blurIn`, `slideIn`, `typewriter`, `marker` |

Each phase is an object:

| Attribute | Type | Values | Default | Description |
|-----------|------|--------|---------|-------------|
| `preset` | string | the phase's presets, above |  | Required. Id of the preset. |
| `duration` | number | ≥ 0 |  | Duration in milliseconds. Missing means the preset's own duration. |
| `ease` | string | an ease, see [Eases](#eases) |  | Easing. Missing means the preset's own easing. |
| `params` | object |  |  | Parameters some animation presets use. |
| `params.distance` | number | 0–100 | `5` | Travel distance of slide, drop, shake, bounce, float and glow, in percent of the smaller side of the video stage. |
| `params.color` | string |  |  | CSS colour of glow and marker. |
| `iterations` | integer | ≥ 0 | `0` | `emphasis` only: how often the loop plays. 0 fills the span. |
| `mode` | string | `word`, `letter` |  | `text` only: reveal word by word or letter by letter. Missing means the preset's own mode, or word. |
| `stagger` | number | ≥ 0 |  | `text` only: delay between words or letters in milliseconds. |

### Eases

Id of an easing function. The animation phases take one, as do keyframes (the segment to the next keyframe) and the `counter` type.

`linear`, `hold`, `ease`, `easeIn`, `easeOut`, `easeInOut`, `gentleOut`, `power1In`, `power1Out`, `power1InOut`, `power2In`, `power2Out`, `power2InOut`, `power3In`, `power3Out`, `power3InOut`, `power4In`, `power4Out`, `power4InOut`, `sineIn`, `sineOut`, `sineInOut`, `expoIn`, `expoOut`, `expoInOut`, `circIn`, `circOut`, `circInOut`, `backIn`, `backOut`, `backInOut`, `springGentle`, `springQuick`, `springBouncy`, `springSlow`, `wiggle`, `wiggleBounce`
